description: A multi-step data pipeline where each stage is reviewed before proceeding.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a DataCollector gathers data, a Reviewer checks it, a Processor transforms it, and a FinalReviewer approves before storage.

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.system_prompt: Review collected data for quality. If not approved, return to DataCollector.

agents.name: FinalReviewer
agents.system_prompt: Approve processed data for storage. If not approved, return to Processor.

description: A chatbot workflow where escalation occurs to a human agent if the bot cannot resolve the issue.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Chatbot answers user queries, escalates to a Specialist if it cannot help, and finally to a HumanAgent if the Specialist cannot resolve.

agents.name: Chatbot
agents.system_prompt: Answer user queries. If unable, escalate to Specialist.

agents.name: Specialist
agents.system_prompt: Handle complex queries. If unable, escalate to HumanAgent.

description: A workflow for automated code review and approval using MCP GitHub tools.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a CodeReviewer checks PRs using GitHub MCP tools, a LeadReviewer gives final approval, and a Merger merges the PR if approved.

agents.name: CodeReviewer
agents.system_prompt: Review pull requests using GitHub MCP tools.

description: A workflow for generating, editing, and publishing content with multiple agents.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Writer drafts content, an Editor refines it, a Proofreader checks for errors, and a Publisher posts the final version.

agents.name: Proofreader
agents.system_prompt: Check for errors and suggest corrections.

description: Agents collaborate to research, synthesize, and present findings.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Researcher gathers information, a Synthesizer combines insights, and a Presenter creates a summary report.

agents.name: Presenter
agents.system_prompt: Create a summary report based on synthesized findings.
